title: Publish versioned CC-BY corpus (lessons + exercises + tests) + provenance manifest
context: open-coding-curriculum is an open CC-BY (prose) / MIT (code) curriculum of beginner programming lessons with graded, runnable exercises across languages. Every exercise carries a reference solution proven correct in CI (solutionVerified:true), learner code runs zero-install in-browser via WASM, and all content is machine-readable structured data so third parties can build on it. The project targets absolute beginners — self-learners, public-library patrons, under-resourced school students, career-changers — and operates under a donated-compute lane with no server-side execution of learner code and no partner confirmed yet (verifiedNeed:false). The versioned CC-BY corpus dataset is what makes the project reusable and forkable by third parties — courses, offline bundles, apps. It must include per-asset license and provenance, the solutionVerified status per exercise, and the pinned runtime version so correctness is reproducible. This is also the fallback 'delivered' artifact if Gate G1 is a no-go.
objective: Export and publish the complete lesson + exercise + test corpus as a versioned, machine-readable dataset with per-asset provenance (license, isOriginal, source URLs), solutionVerified status, and pinned runtime versions.
acceptanceCriteria: Complete corpus is exported as a single versioned dataset (version number and date in filename/metadata).
Every lesson carries: prose license (CC-BY-4.0), authors, and sources.
Every exercise carries: code license (MIT or CC0), isOriginal flag, source URL (if not original), solutionVerified status, and pinned runtime version.
A provenance manifest lists every asset with its license, origin, and verification status.
A published attribution string is included so downstream reusers know how to attribute the corpus.
Dataset is published to a stable, citable location (e.g. repository release or dataset host) with a DOI or equivalent stable URL.
output: A versioned, publicly available CC-BY dataset containing the full lesson + exercise + test corpus with provenance manifest, attribution string, and license declarations.
